title: Isolate retry-budget exhaustion from the first HTTP response’s one-second race
outcome: Isolate retry-budget exhaustion from the first HTTP response’s one-second race
acceptance: delegation_mcp_bridge_stops_replaying_when_the_overall_budget_cannot_fund_a_retry deterministically obtains the typed503 rejection before applying an exhausted replay budget, using a logical budget/owned transport seam.
Retain exactly one request, zero replay sleeps and typed SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE assertions; do not inflate production budgets, retry the test or accept a transport timeout as equivalent.
